# doXmind Documentation

> doXmind is a local-first desktop workspace for Markdown, PDF, and spreadsheets. It requires no account and does not provide cloud document storage, telemetry, or a built-in AI runtime.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://docs.doxmind.com/introduction): Product model, privacy, availability, and Save versus Export.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.doxmind.com/quickstart): Install the Apple silicon macOS app and open a local workspace.

## Workspaces

- [Open files and folders](https://docs.doxmind.com/workspaces/opening-files)
- [Manage files](https://docs.doxmind.com/workspaces/file-management)
- [Local storage and sidecars](https://docs.doxmind.com/workspaces/storage-and-sidecars)

## Editors

- [Markdown editor](https://docs.doxmind.com/markdown/editor)

- [Edit and annotate PDFs](https://docs.doxmind.com/pdf/edit-and-annotate)
- [Edit spreadsheets](https://docs.doxmind.com/spreadsheets/workbooks)
